## Scientific meetings and seminars

::: cv-entry
**Soil Imaging Network meeting** [2024 · 4 hours]{.cv-date}\
*INRAE Soil Imaging Network, Montpellier, France*\
Talks on microscopy imaging (tools, methods and applications across disciplines) and a round table on data management and open science. Scientific monitoring of soil imaging techniques and projects. Flash talk on the in situ imaging technique I work on: "In situ soil imaging for monitoring edaphic biological activity".
:::

::: cv-entry
**12th Scientific and Technical Days of the Microscopists network** [2024 · 3 days]{.cv-date}\
*INRAE Microscopists network, Montpellier, France*\
Talks on microscopy imaging and a round table on data management and open science. Technical knowledge of imaging techniques in biology and scientific data management. Oral dissemination skills (pedagogy, outreach) through a workshop on innovative imaging techniques at UMR Eco&Sols.
:::

::: cv-entry
**12th Scientific Days of the TEBIS network** [2024 · 3 days]{.cv-date}\
*TEBIS network, Montpellier, France*\
Presentation: "Development of an in situ imaging method to monitor the phenology of edaphic activity", on perspectives for building phenological traits for soil fauna. Statistical training in multivariate trait analysis, macro-video digitisation workshop on soil mesofauna, and conferences on traits in soil ecology.
:::

::: cv-entry
**Seminar: Contributions, benefits and limits of remote sensing for better understanding biodiversity** [2023 · 2 days]{.cv-date}\
*BIOSEFAIR INRAE metaprogramme, Castelnau-le-Lez, France*\
Presentations of projects using remote sensing to monitor biodiversity, and of tools and methodologies used to address ecological questions. Exchange session between ecologists and remote-sensing specialists on the needs of each discipline for biodiversity monitoring projects.
:::
